title: Sycophancy Induction via DPO on Llama-3 vs. Qwen2.5 at 7B Scale

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Understanding whether sycophancy is a dataset or model-family artifact is useful but somewhat diagnostic. The chain from this finding to a concrete safety intervention is indirect—it informs where to intervene but does not directly test an intervention.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: DPO training with TRL is documented but requires constructing a sycophantic preference dataset, which involves design choices. Running DPO on two 7B models needs medium compute. Feasible but not trivial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two model families to train and evaluate, plus dataset construction. The dataset construction is open-ended and could take significant time. Tight for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
